states.narration: Find the identical product x times y in each term. Its multipliers follow the group: three in the first term and four in the second.
Keep the shared product on the left. Collect the original multipliers on the right as three plus four, without swapping any factors.
Three plus four is seven. Only the right-hand multiplier is evaluated; x times y remains the same product on the left.

editorial.title: Collect a product with multipliers after it
editorial.setup: Treat x times y as one repeated unit. Track the multipliers to its right while keeping the two factors inside the group together.
editorial.summary: The right-hand multipliers combine as three plus four, giving seven. Collecting the terms neither changes the product x times y nor determines its value.
